states.basis: Retained ČÚZK DMR5G 2 m Float32 raster, Bpv heights and 10201-value native grid. Y0 is the 300 m Bpv working datum; signed placement subtracts sampled relative anchor height. Mapped occupied foundations extend below grade; host terrain supplies open courts and hillside. Component floors and passage heights are reconstructions, not surveyed elevations.

limits: 2m Float32 DMR5G bare-earth raster sampled to a4m native review grid. Model datum300mBpv is reconstructed,not a surveyed castle floor.
Under occupied buildings the bare-earth product interpolates. Working floors use highest mapped perimeter sample plus0.25m; that estimate requires architectural survey.
Acquisition2009–2013 stated by service; terrain and restoration changes since then are not established.
Horizontal transformation operation accuracy is retained. Terrain supply/vintage in each host may differ from this bounded review fixture.
Clipped raster/grid source evidence stays outside runtime GLBs; no filled court plinth, whole-enclosure cutout or duplicated castle hill.

inspection.notes: Actually inspected all 25 final images. The retained hillside supplies open ground; mapped foundations are visible from outside after fixing ring winding. Great Tower, lower Well, gate/stairs and timber skyway persist across four browser levels. Far levels intentionally remove small openings and stair treads. Architectural floor estimates and sampled bare-earth interpolation remain limitations.
